records.title:
EXPANSION AND IMPROVEMENT FACILITY AT RANCHI AIRPORT
IN JHARKHAND
details:
The Airports
Authority of India (AAI) has undertaken construction of a Parallel Taxi Track
(PTT), Rapid Exit Track (RET), Extension of Apron, Reconfiguration of existing
Terminal Building to augment capacity and Installation of CAT-II Lighting System
at Ranchi Airport in Jharkhand. These development works are at various stages of
completion.
